variables.name: STORYBOOK_MOCK_API_PATH
variables.defaultValue: '/storybook-mock-api'
variables.rawdescription:
Storybook-only mock of the DCP asset hierarchy (the data behind the Global Filter).
Stories point `HttpConfig.gatewayUrl` here and MSW (see asset-hierarchy-mock-api.ts) answers
`/{siteId}/asset-hierarchy/hierarchy/next?link=…` and `/{siteId}/asset-hierarchy/hierarchy/{webId}/meta-data`.

Like the real API, the suffix of an element `Link` tells which kind of level its children form:
`…/level` -> next level, `…/group` -> equipment group, `…/sensor` -> sensors (final step).
variables.description:
Storybook-only mock of the DCP asset hierarchy (the data behind the Global Filter). Stories point HttpConfig.gatewayUrl here and MSW (see asset-hierarchy-mock-api.ts) answers /{siteId}/asset-hierarchy/hierarchy/next?link=… and /{siteId}/asset-hierarchy/hierarchy/{webId}/meta-data.

Like the real API, the suffix of an element Link tells which kind of level its children form: …/level -> next level, …/group -> equipment group, …/sensor -> sensors (final step).

projects/open-dcp/angular-asset-navigato.rawdescription:
Storybook-only mock of the DCP asset hierarchy (the data behind the Global Filter).
Stories point `HttpConfig.gatewayUrl` here and MSW (see asset-hierarchy-mock-api.ts) answers
`/{siteId}/asset-hierarchy/hierarchy/next?link=…` and `/{siteId}/asset-hierarchy/hierarchy/{webId}/meta-data`.

Like the real API, the suffix of an element `Link` tells which kind of level its children form:
`…/level` -> next level, `…/group` -> equipment group, `…/sensor` -> sensors (final step).

Like the real API, the suffix of an element Link tells which kind of level its children form: …/level -> next level, …/group -> equipment group, …/sensor -> sensors (final step).
